newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-STEWART PUTS SURREY IN CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-STEWART PUTS SURREY IN CHARGE.

text.p: England's Alec Stewart hammered a career-best 271 not out to put Surrey in firm control of their English county championship match against Yorkshire on Friday.
The England wicketkeeper-batsman struck 36 fours and three sixes as Surrey piled up 549 all out in their first innings.
Yorkshire also enjoyed the excellent batting conditions, moving to 226 for four with Australian Darren Lehmann unbeaten on 61 after two days' play.
Kent fast bowler Ben Phillips scored his first championship century to give his side the upperhand against Lancashire.
Phillips finished unbeaten on 100 in Kent's first innings total of 373 and then picked up the prized wicket of Neil Fairbrother as Lancashire stumbled to 113 for five in reply.
A tense finish is in store in a low-scoring match at Basingstoke where Hampshire set Somerset a victory target of 235 runs.
Australia's Matthew Hayden (63) played the major hand in Hampshire's econd innings total of 189. Medium-pacer Graham Rose collected five for 53 for Somerset.
South Africa's Jacques Kallis (96) pushed Middlesex to 251 for five in their first innings to leave them 30 runs behind Glamorgan.
At Hove, Sussex were still 24 runs in arrears at 220 for five in their second innings against Essex. Ronnie Irani hit 110 in 144 balls to carry Essex to 384 all out in their first innings.
